summary: First test run for New Eden Fleet Cartographer MVP. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests passed (SDE systems endpoint, live NPSI report 622 meta/totals/hotspots/regions/unmapped, and 404 handling). Frontend: full end-to-end UI flow verified - star map canvas renders, summary panel shows fleet name 'K-FLEET: ShrinkWrapped pew pew!', FC keacte, stats (Kills 65, ISK 6.76b, Fleet Size 57, Systems 15), region roam bars (Immensea/Catch/Tenerifis/Curse/Genesis), 65 killmail rows, click-to-filter by system worked (Q-S7ZD shows 9 kills), clear-filter chip, Members tab shows 57 members, and report reload via input+Map button works.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: fetch failures propagate as 502 which is good; consider caching NPSI responses briefly to reduce repeated live-hits during retries.
eve_sde.py: _load() is not thread-safe on first-load races but effectively harmless with FastAPI async workers; fine for MVP.
FleetMap.jsx & StarMap.jsx are cleanly separated and well within size limits; d3+canvas approach is appropriate.
Hotspot tooltip is not testable via DOM until user hovers a canvas element (documented limitation - not a bug).
seed_data_creation: None - app is read-only over NPSI live API + bundled SDE data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All primary flows validated against live NPSI report 622. Backend tests can be re-run at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. If NPSI changes report 622's data, tighten assertions accordingly.
